comparisons.peer_topic: Other Income (Expense), Net Composition and Results
comparisons.peer_summary: Other income (expense), net totaled $181 million in 2024, down from $197 million in 2023, primarily due to decreased interest income from lower short-term investment balances; this line item is primarily comprised of interest income from short-term investments, changes in valuation of equity investments, and foreign currency transaction gains and losses.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose 'Other, net' (or 'Other income (expense), net') as comprising gains/losses from non-affiliated investments and foreign currency impacts. However, the primary driver of change differs significantly: AMD attributes its year-over-year decrease primarily to 'decreased interest income from lower balances held in short-term investments,' whereas NVDA attributes its change to 'changes in value from our non-affiliated investments,' with no mention of interest income changes as a driver.

sentences.text: Other, net, consists of realized or unrealized gains and losses from investments in non-affiliated entities and the impact of changes in foreign currency rates.
Change in Other, net, compared to fiscal year 2023 was driven by changes in value from our non-affiliated investments.
Other income (expense), net is primarily comprised of interest income from short-term investments, changes in valuation of equity investments and foreign currency transaction gains and losses.
The change was primarily due to a decrease in interest income from lower balances held in short-term investments compared to the prior year.
